rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for goods or merchandise.

example.english: This batch of goods is pretty good value.
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 gei2 dai2 maai5

rows.note: Use this for goods viewed as commercial products for sale, especially in business or retail contexts.

example.english: These goods sell very well in the online shop.
example.traditional: 呢啲商品喺網店賣得好好。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 soeng1 ban2 hai2 mong5 dim3 maai6 dak1 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for goods as a shipment or consignment, rather than ordinary merchandise in general.

example.english: The goods have already been delivered to the warehouse.
example.jyutping: fo3 mat6 ji5 ging1 sung3 dou3 cong1 fu3
